newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Jan 24.

text.p: Mexican port Veracruz was shut Friday because of dense fog and the rest of the nation's major ports reported open, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

A weak cold front heading west and southwest along the coast bringing cloudy skies and lower temperatures. Winds from the northwest at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 17 miles per hour) with waves three to five feet high.

Cold front heading southeast to affect northwest Gulf of Mexico later in the day, lowering temperatures and possibly bringing rains. Winds could increase to 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/17 to 22 miles per hour) and waves from four to six feet.
Winds along the rest of the coast from the southeast at 10 to 15 knots at waves three to five feet high.
Moderate convective activity moving west along the coasts of Quintana Roo, Honduras and Nicaragua with possible rains. Winds from the east at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
